cases.name: fixed one-hop ExpandInto preserves typed relationship identity
cases.cypher: MATCH (s:ExpandIntoSource), (e:ExpandIntoTarget) WHERE s.name = 'source' AND e.name = 'target' MATCH (s)-[r:ExpandIntoKindA]->(e) RETURN type(r), r.slot

cases.name: fixed one-hop ExpandInto preserves wildcard cross-kind multiplicity
cases.cypher: MATCH (s:ExpandIntoSource), (e:ExpandIntoTarget) WHERE s.name = 'source' AND e.name = 'target' MATCH (s)-[r]->(e) RETURN type(r), r.slot ORDER BY type(r)

cases.name: fixed one-hop ExpandInto preserves multi-kind relationship rows
cases.cypher: MATCH (s:ExpandIntoSource), (e:ExpandIntoTarget) WHERE s.name = 'source' AND e.name = 'target' MATCH (s)-[r:ExpandIntoKindA|ExpandIntoKindB]->(e) RETURN type(r), r.slot ORDER BY type(r)

cases.name: fixed one-hop ExpandInto reapplies duplicate outer pair multiplicity
cases.cypher: MATCH (s:ExpandIntoSource), (e:ExpandIntoTarget) WHERE s.name = 'source' AND e.name = 'target' WITH s, e, [1, 2] AS copies UNWIND copies AS copy MATCH (s)-[r:ExpandIntoKindA|ExpandIntoKindB]->(e) RETURN copy, type(r) ORDER BY copy, type(r)

cases.name: fixed one-hop ExpandInto recognizes node endpoints introduced by UNWIND
cases.cypher: MATCH (s:ExpandIntoSource), (e:ExpandIntoTarget) WHERE s.name = 'source' AND e.name = 'target' WITH collect(s) AS sources, e UNWIND sources AS source MATCH (source)-[r:ExpandIntoKindA]->(e) RETURN r.slot

cases.name: fixed one-hop ExpandInto preserves self loop
cases.cypher: MATCH (s:ExpandIntoSource), (e:ExpandIntoTarget) WHERE s.name = 'loop' AND e.name = 'loop' MATCH (s)-[r:ExpandIntoKindA]->(e) RETURN type(r), r.slot

cases.name: fixed one-hop ExpandInto missing pair is empty
cases.cypher: MATCH (s:ExpandIntoSource), (e:ExpandIntoTarget) WHERE s.name = 'missing' AND e.name = 'target' MATCH (s)-[r]->(e) RETURN r

cases.name: fixed one-hop ExpandInto preserves a pair when the source has lower degree
cases.cypher: MATCH (s:ExpandIntoSource), (e:ExpandIntoTarget) WHERE s.name = 'low-source' AND e.name = 'high-target' MATCH (s)-[r:ExpandIntoKindA]->(e) RETURN r.slot

cases.name: fixed one-hop ExpandInto preserves a pair when the target has lower degree
cases.cypher: MATCH (s:ExpandIntoSource), (e:ExpandIntoTarget) WHERE s.name = 'high-source' AND e.name = 'low-target' MATCH (s)-[r:ExpandIntoKindA]->(e) RETURN r.slot

cases.name: fixed one-hop ExpandInto preserves reversed directionless cross-kind multiplicity
cases.cypher: MATCH (s:ExpandIntoTarget), (e:ExpandIntoSource) WHERE s.name = 'target' AND e.name = 'source' MATCH (s)-[r:ExpandIntoKindA|ExpandIntoKindB]-(e) RETURN type(r), r.slot ORDER BY type(r)

cases.name: fixed one-hop ExpandInto preserves inbound cross-kind multiplicity
cases.cypher: MATCH (s:ExpandIntoTarget), (e:ExpandIntoSource) WHERE s.name = 'target' AND e.name = 'source' MATCH (s)<-[r:ExpandIntoKindA|ExpandIntoKindB]-(e) RETURN type(r), r.slot ORDER BY type(r)

cases.name: fixed one-hop ExpandInto emits a directionless self loop once
cases.cypher: MATCH (s:ExpandIntoSource), (e:ExpandIntoTarget) WHERE s.name = 'loop' AND e.name = 'loop' MATCH (s)-[r:ExpandIntoKindA]-(e) RETURN type(r), r.slot

cases.name: fixed one-hop directionless traversal emits an unbound self loop once
cases.cypher: MATCH (s:ExpandIntoSource)-[r:ExpandIntoKindA]-(e:ExpandIntoTarget) WHERE r.slot = 'loop' RETURN type(r), r.slot

cases.name: fixed one-hop directionless traversal emits a single-bound self loop once
cases.cypher: MATCH (s:ExpandIntoSource) WHERE s.name = 'loop' MATCH (s)-[r:ExpandIntoKindA]-(e:ExpandIntoTarget) RETURN type(r), r.slot

cases.name: fixed one-hop ExpandInto preserves arbitrary varying bound pairs
cases.cypher: MATCH (s:ExpandIntoSource), (e:ExpandIntoTarget) WHERE (s.name = 'source' AND e.name = 'target') OR (s.name = 'low-source' AND e.name = 'high-target') MATCH (s)-[r:ExpandIntoKindA]->(e) RETURN s.name, e.name, r.slot ORDER BY s.name

cases.name: optional fixed one-hop ExpandInto preserves null relationship rows
cases.cypher: MATCH (s:ExpandIntoSource), (e:ExpandIntoTarget) WHERE s.name = 'missing' AND e.name = 'target' OPTIONAL MATCH (s)-[r:ExpandIntoKindA]->(e) RETURN s.name, e.name, r.slot

cases.name: fixed one-hop ExpandInto composes with multiple path bindings
cases.cypher: MATCH (s:ExpandIntoSource), (e:ExpandIntoTarget) WHERE s.name = 'source' AND e.name = 'target' MATCH p = (s)-[r:ExpandIntoKindA]->(e) MATCH q = (s)-[r2:ExpandIntoKindB]->(e) RETURN length(p), length(q), r.slot, r2.slot
